recipe.text: Fresh melee-brute concept: a slow, heavy Molten Golem distinct from prior husks. Spawned a native R15 block rig, recolored to warm Slate stone with dark head, added oversized neon-orange eyes, three welded neon lava-crack strips on the torso, and neon lava hands for a light-on-dark accent silhouette that reads against the arena floor. make_npc gives it server AI idle->chase->attack->dead with brute stats (40 dmg / 2.5s, WalkSpeed 6, detect 24, attackRange 7).
